scope: Public read-only x402 List indexed-service/monitored-facilitator stats and x402stats wallet-flow heuristics. Different measurement populations; do not sum or reconcile them as one ecosystem census.

sources.caveat: Publisher-measured listed services and measured facilitators only; not all x402; buyer addresses are not distinct paying companies; top-service flow imported.

Publisher-defined wash filtering and organic wallet thresholds; wallet counts are not independently verified businesses or AgentMine customers. 30-day headline vs dated weekly observation must not be treated as an exact point-in-time census.

within_same_publisher_comparison.caveat: Overlapping rolling windows, changing measured coverage, potential index and methodology changes. Descriptive publisher snapshots only, not causal growth/decline estimates or validated customer demand.

derived_descriptive_ratios.caveat: Ratios are arithmetic on publisher aggregates, not verified seller market share or independently validated payments.

strategic_gate: Do not prioritize generic x402 directory, payment discovery or transaction-fee exchange from catalog/flow totals. Focus on a narrow workflow with independently consented buyer intent, repeat usage, incremental time/cost savings and explicit willingness to pay; compare against incumbent.
